 "data": "
flowchart TD
 A{\"Choose an Action<br/>Start: Battery 10% · Distance 3 blocks\"}

 A -->|GPS · Cost 4%| B{Battery ≥ 4?}
 A -->|Call for Directions · Cost 3%| C{Battery ≥ 3?}
 A -->|Ask a Stranger · Cost 2%| D{Battery ≥ 2?}
 A -->|Walk Randomly · Cost 1%| E{Battery ≥ 1?}

 B -->|No| F[Show: Not enough battery]
 C -->|No| F
 D -->|No| F
 E -->|No| F
 F --> A

 B -->|Yes| G[Battery −4%]
 C -->|Yes| H[Battery −3%<br/>Roll a 10-sided die<br/>Show the result]
 D -->|Yes| I[Battery −2%<br/>Roll a 10-sided die<br/>Show the result]
 E -->|Yes| J[Battery −1%<br/>Roll a 10-sided die<br/>Show the result]

 G --> K[Move closer: Distance −1]
 H --> L{Roll ≤ 8?}
 I --> M{Roll ≤ 5?}
 J --> N{Roll ≤ 3?}

 L -->|Yes| K
 L -->|No| O[Wrong way: Distance +1]
 M -->|Yes| K
 M -->|No| P[No directions: Stay in place]
 N -->|Yes| K
 N -->|No| O

 K --> Q[Show outcome, battery and distance]
 O --> Q
 P --> Q

 Q --> R{Distance = 0?}
 R -->|Yes| S([You made it home!])
 R -->|No| T{Battery = 0?}
 T -->|Yes| U([Battery dead. Game over!])
 T -->|No| A
```",
